source_documents.title: Advantages of Mobile Liquid-Crystal Phase of AIE Luminogens for Effective Solid-State Emission

reference_evidence_units.quote: Bulk sam- ples were prepared by fast evaporation with an aspirator vac- uum pump.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Compound 2 (eight-dodecyl-chain TPE derivative)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Fast-dried bulk at room temperature versus self-assembled THF/water aggregates; temperature-dependent PL/TCSPC excited at 375 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The bulk comparison uses rapid solvent removal, which can leave heterogeneous local packing.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This preparation detail is shared by 1-3 and is important to the source's defect-site explanation.

reference_evidence_units.quote: bulks 1 and 2 show hexagonal and rectangular columnar LC phases at room temperature, respec- tively.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Compound 2 (eight-dodecyl-chain TPE derivative)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Fast-dried bulk at room temperature versus self-assembled THF/water aggregates; temperature-dependent PL/TCSPC excited at 375 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Compound 2 forms a rectangular columnar LC phase at room temperature, not the hexagonal phase of compound 1.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Assignment is from earlier XRD work cited in this main paper.

reference_evidence_units.subject: Compound 2 (eight-dodecyl-chain TPE derivative)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Fast-dried bulk at room temperature versus self-assembled THF/water aggregates; temperature-dependent PL/TCSPC excited at 375 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Table 1 gives bulk 2 absorption/emission 456/513 nm, emission bandwidth 3950 cm^-1, Stokes shift 2450 cm^-1 and yield 0.33; THF/water aggregate yield is 0.19.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Table visually inspected. Prose on PDF p3 inconsistently gives bandwidth 2450 cm^-1, apparently repeating the Stokes shift.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the radiative rates of bulks 1 and 2 are 2.9 and 2.0 times accelerated
reference_evidence_units.subject: Compound 2 (eight-dodecyl-chain TPE derivative)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Fast-dried bulk at room temperature versus self-assembled THF/water aggregates; temperature-dependent PL/TCSPC excited at 375 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Bulk 2's derived radiative rate doubles relative to its THF/water aggregate: 1.4 versus 0.69 x10^8 s^-1; nonradiative rates are similar, 2.8 versus 2.9 x10^8 s^-1.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Rates are calculated from yield and amplitude-averaged lifetime, not independent microscopic measurements; compound 1's 2.9-fold change is not transferred.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the red-shifted absorption and emission bands and the acceler- ated radiative rates of bulks 1 and 2 are caused by J-type transi- tion dipole-dipole coupling
reference_evidence_units.subject: Compound 2 (eight-dodecyl-chain TPE derivative)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Fast-dried bulk at room temperature versus self-assembled THF/water aggregates; temperature-dependent PL/TCSPC excited at 375 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors propose J-type coupling in zigzag columns as the explanation for spectral shifts and faster radiation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Spectroscopic/packing inference using a point-dipole approximation, not direct exciton-wavefunction measurement.

reference_evidence_units.quote: probably due to thermally activated intra- molecular motions and a subsequently accelerated nonradiative decay process
reference_evidence_units.subject: Compound 2 (eight-dodecyl-chain TPE derivative)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Fast-dried bulk at room temperature versus self-assembled THF/water aggregates; temperature-dependent PL/TCSPC excited at 375 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Initial thermal PL quenching is interpreted as activation of intramolecular motions.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is a proposed temperature effect, not the main reason bulk 2 outperforms solvent aggregates.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The 55% faster nonradiative rate of bulk 2 compared to that of bulk 1 is presumably caused by an imper- fect stacking condition
reference_evidence_units.subject: Compound 2 (eight-dodecyl-chain TPE derivative)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Fast-dried bulk at room temperature versus self-assembled THF/water aggregates; temperature-dependent PL/TCSPC excited at 375 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Bulk 2's lower mobility and imperfect stacking are proposed to increase nonradiative loss relative to bulk 1.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Heterogeneity/defect attribution is inferential, not direct counting of trap states.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The rearrange- ments of TPE derivatives of bulks 2 and 3 occur gradually over a wide temperature range, from 140 ℃ to the isotropization temperature.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Compound 2 (eight-dodecyl-chain TPE derivative)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Fast-dried bulk at room temperature versus self-assembled THF/water aggregates; temperature-dependent PL/TCSPC excited at 375 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Temperature-dependent intensity/lifetime and DSC behavior are assigned to gradual rearrangement above about 140 C.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Compound 2 and 3 share the trend, but their phase states and transition temperatures differ.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Preserve the weaker explicit thermal-motion explanation; no claim that stronger restriction causes the main bulk enhancement.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Columnar arrangement, mobility and imperfect stacking control both useful coupling and loss channels.

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Proposed J-type coupling explains the faster radiative process in bulk 2, with the source's approximate exciton assignment retained.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Derived rates identify radiative acceleration, not additional knr suppression, as the principal bulk-versus-solvent-aggregate advantage; overlaps with the J assignment.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Preserve the weaker explicit thermal-motion explanation; no claim that stronger restriction causes the main bulk enhancement.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Columnar arrangement, mobility and imperfect stacking control both useful coupling and loss channels.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No guest binding, pore uptake or host inclusion mechanism is established; a solvent or self-assembly is not automatically host-guest chemistry.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific CT or TICT mechanism is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific excited-state proton-transfer pathway is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on is established; energy transfer and CT character are not by themselves PET.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Proposed J-type coupling explains the faster radiative process in bulk 2, with the source's approximate exciton assignment retained.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Derived rates identify radiative acceleration, not additional knr suppression, as the principal bulk-versus-solvent-aggregate advantage; overlaps with the J assignment.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No operative target-specific triplet or metal-mediated pathway is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection mechanism is established; rotation restriction alone does not prove CI access.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-singlet-state emission or anti-Kasha mechanism is established; higher-state absorption alone is insufficient.
